metadata.title: Calibrations close to $\mathrm{G}_2$-twistor space
metadata.abstract: We study natural structures of the kind of $\mathrm{G}_2$ existing on the unit tangent sphere bundle $SM \rightarrow M$ of any oriented Riemannian 4-manifold $M$. Based on the Harvey-Morgan classification of degree 3 calibrations on $\mathbb{R}^7$, we identity those which can be found on $SM$. We also study the Laplacian of the Sasaki metric on 3-forms.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究定向黎曼四流形单位切球丛上的 G₂ 型自然结构，利用七维三次校准分类识别可出现的校准，并计算 Sasaki 度量作用于三形式的 Laplacian。
analysis.breakthrough: 将线性七维校准与由四维底空间产生的自然结构联系起来。
analysis.limitations: G₂ 型结构不自动意味着无挠 G₂ holonomy，摘要未给一般存在或完整校准子流形分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
